cards.title: MLB - Yankees
cards.recap:
Yankees last played at home against Red Sox. The result was W 6-3 vs Red Sox (Sep 1).

Record: 82-57 | Division: 1st in AL East, 2.0 games ahead of Baltimore
Winning pitcher: Carlos Rodon (15-7)
Losing pitcher: Brayan Bello (11-9)
Save: Clay Holmes (31)
Yankees HR: Aaron Judge and Anthony Volpe
Game flow: The Yankees were tied 3-3 after six innings before taking control with a two-run seventh and an insurance run in the eighth.
Recap: Rodon gave New York six solid innings, the bullpen protected the tie, and Holmes finished it off in the ninth.
Highlights: Judge hit a two-run homer to left, Volpe added a solo shot, and the Yankees stranded Boston in the late innings.

cards.title: NFL - Steelers
cards.recap:
Steelers last played on the road against Bengals. The result was W 24-20 @ Bengals (Sep 13).

Record: 1-0 | Division: 1st in AFC North, tied with Baltimore
Steelers QB: Will Howard - 22-of-31, 248 yards, 2 TD, 1 INT
Top RB: Jaylen Warren - 18 carries, 96 yards, 1 TD
Top WR: George Pickens - 7 catches, 104 yards, 1 TD
Turnovers: Steelers 1, Bengals 2
Recap: The Steelers leaned on balance rather than explosive plays and controlled the key moments late in the game.
Game flow: Pittsburgh scored on back-to-back second-half drives and then sealed the win with a fourth-quarter stop after Cincinnati crossed midfield.

cards.recap:
Southern 500 at Darlington Raceway on Sep 1. Winner: Kyle Larson.

Recap: Larson took control on the final restart, cleared traffic quickly, and held the lead over the closing laps despite repeated pressure behind him.
Highlights: Several late cautions reset the field, the top contenders shuffled on pit road, and the final green-flag run decided the finish.
